svg.title: Fsm Wall Following
svg.desc: Two-state machine for wall following. State 1, right wall follow (forward velocity, angular velocity = Kp times (d_ref minus d_right)), switches to state 2, left turn, when the front distance is below the stop threshold; state 2 (turning speed, angular velocity from the front distance) switches back when the front distance exceeds the start threshold. Marius-Juston 2026
